purpose: Cool-region palette trials + the re-freeze they produced. data/palette.json HAD been fitted over the 5 gate-B0 sources, which are warm/green and carry almost no cyan, blue or magenta; the 14 cool trials below asked whether it should be re-fitted over a broadened source set, and this file is the provenance both for the asking and for the answer they got.
status: SETTLED — the images below are still trials (none is an approved or shipped asset, so G5 is untouched), but the question they were run to answer has been decided. data/palette.json was RE-FROZEN on 2026-08-26 at T-15 to the sRGB / class-equal fit: still `frozen: true`, still colorCount 32, still the same positional ids c00-c31 in the same order — a VALUE SWAP, not a schema change. It is therefore no longer UNTOUCHED. `palettes.frozen.colorsSha256` EQUALS `palettes.classEqual.colorsSha256`, and that equality is CHECKED here from the bytes on disk rather than asserted — the match IS the record of the promotion. See `palettes.frozen.sources` for what it was fitted over, quoted verbatim from the freeze itself.
_readme: Regenerate with `npx tsx tools/palette/build-manifest-palette.ts`. Rows are read back from assets/raw/palette-trials/_run{1,2}.json; every sha256 is computed from the bytes on disk. `purpose`, `status`, `_seedRule`, `_generationCount` and the `palettes` block are DERIVED at write time from data/palette.json and tools/palette/candidate-sources.json — do not hand-edit them, because a re-freeze must move them and a literal here would not (it did not, once, which is why they are derived). The build refuses outright if data/palette.json is not `frozen: true`, if the rows stop sharing one seed, or if a row or top-level block would be dropped. tools/comfy/manifest.json is a concurrent workflow's file — these rows do NOT merge into it, because none of these images is a shipped asset.
_seedRule: Every row uses seed 42, read back from the rows rather than asserted — a split would refuse the build. `manifestDerivedSeed` records what tools/comfy/manifest.json would use for the corresponding SHIPPED row, so the two are never confused. G5 is untouched: no approved asset is regenerated here, and no row here is approved.

_generationCount.g13: Under the 20-item threshold, so build-doc G13's credit estimate + --confirm gate does not apply.

_subjectProvenance: Round-1 subjects are the `prompt` field of the named `tools/comfy/manifest.json` row, VERBATIM — that file is the G2-gated transcription of bible §4 (species) and §6 (towns), so the trial prompt is the exact string B3/B4 will submit for that asset. Round-2 subjects vary ONLY the anatomy clause and the view clause, for the reasons recorded per row.

frozen.sources: k-means over 19 trials (player, fox, croc, trainer, map, brackwater, r2-marsh, duskhollow, cindershelf, fenmaw, puddlisk, bogling, mirefin, undermere, duskstalk, wispurr, gloomoth, sporantle, webvern), sRGB / class-equal weighting, seed 42 — re-frozen at T-15, superseding the 5-trial B0 freeze of 2026-08-25
frozen.method: weighted k-means, k=32, k-means++ init seeded at 42 via core/rng.ts (no Math.random, G11); fit space sRGB; class-equal weighting
frozen._derived: Every field here is read from data/palette.json at write time; `colorsSha256` is hashed from its `colors`, and `isClassEqualFit` is that hash COMPARED against assets/approved-trials/_palette-candidate/palette.candidate-classequal.json — it is a measurement, not a claim. Do not hand-edit: a re-freeze must move all of it.

candidate.method: srgb / equal per-image, k-means++ seeded 42 — the gate-B0 method with a broadened INPUT

classEqual.method: srgb / class-equal — same source set, each ASSET CLASS given an equal vote
classEqual.why: Measured secondary option. Over 19 images "equal per image" no longer delivers the thing it was chosen for at B0 ("every asset class gets an equal vote"), because the class census is now overworld-character×1, creature-battle×12, trainer-battle×1, map-town×4, map-route×1 — counted from tools/palette/candidate-sources.json, folding town-map into map-town the way fit.mjs does.
